title: Trollhunter
review: The troll CGI works because they're only every visible at night, lit by strobes, night vision and the moon. The illusion is broken somewhat by their cartoonish faces. Sometimes I find it satisfying to watch an expert at work, calm and competent. This is a good advert for Land Rover, the troll hunter's choice of reliable transportation. It had a good sense of humour and wasn't really much of a horror film; more of a fantasy road trip.
